rows.ARS:
Apricot or apricot blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: The Cheshire Regiment
rows.Origin:
Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, 1995).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Fryer's Roses/Fryer's Nurseries Ltd. in 1995.
rows.Bloom: Apricot - salmon-orange. Strong fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes: Fryer's Roses says The Cheshire Regiment is an extremely vigorous apricot-salmon...
